probe: instantiate and execute a trivial WASM export before the hostile busy loop

browser-worker.policy: Option A retained: hardened opaque-origin worker CSP omits unsafe-eval/wasm-unsafe-eval; embedded Freenet WASM execution is deliberately unsupported on web
browser-worker.reason: current opaque-origin worker CSP omits unsafe-eval/wasm-unsafe-eval, so Chromium rejects WebAssembly.instantiate

bare-worker-ios-simulator.reason: shipping iOS BareKit (V8 jitless) reports WebAssembly disabled; instantiate is unavailable on the worklet isolate

bare-worker-device.reason: physical BareKit confirmation remains a release gate, not a software prerequisite
bare-worker-device.command: run the in-host benchmark-miniapp action on a physical device

decisionImpact: Option A remains the accepted client model. Browser WASM stays deliberately unsupported. Option B stays closed until physical BareKit evidence (optional relative to simulator software readiness) and a concrete value case versus a supervised Freenet node.
